# satisfactory_resource_nodes (Data Source)

Resource nodes, geysers and water volumes an extractor can be placed on. Miners and water extractors are placed on a world feature rather than at a coordinate; use this to pick one and pass its `id` to `satisfactory_extractor.node_id`. When `x`/`y`/`z` are given the list is sorted by distance from that point (ties by id), otherwise by id - so `nodes[0]` is a stable choice across plans. Only features the game currently has loaded are reported; on a large map that can exclude distant ones.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Every free, non-impure coal node, nearest first, from a point on the map.
data "satisfactory_resource_nodes" "coal" {
  resource = "Desc_Coal_C"
  x        = -77737
  y        = 220338
  z        = -337
}

locals {
  usable_coal = [for n in data.satisfactory_resource_nodes.coal.nodes : n if n.purity != "impure"]
}

output "nearest_coal" {
  value = local.usable_coal[0]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `include_occupied` (Boolean) Also list features that already have an extractor. Set this when selecting nodes by index and filter on `occupant_tf_id` instead, so the nodes this config already owns keep their position in the list from one plan to the next.
- `purity` (String) Keep only nodes of this purity: impure, normal or pure. Water volumes have no purity.
- `radius` (Number) Keep only features within this many centimetres of x/y/z. Requires x, y and z.
- `resource` (String) Keep only features of this resource descriptor class, e.g. Desc_OreIron_C or Desc_Water_C.
- `x` (Number) Centre to sort (and optionally filter) by, in centimetres. x, y and z go together.
- `y` (Number)
- `z` (Number)

### Read-Only

- `nodes` (Attributes List) Matching features, in contract order. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--nodes))

<a id="nestedatt--nodes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `nodes`

Read-Only:

- `bounds_max` (Attributes) Water volumes only: highest corner of the volume's box. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--nodes--bounds_max))
- `bounds_min` (Attributes) Water volumes only: lowest corner of the volume's box. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--nodes--bounds_min))
- `form` (String) solid, liquid, gas or heat.
- `id` (String) Stable id; what satisfactory_extractor.node_id takes.
- `occupant_tf_id` (String) The Terraform-managed extractor on it, if any; empty otherwise.
- `occupied` (Boolean) True when an extractor already sits on it.
- `purity` (String) impure, normal or pure; empty for water.
- `resource` (String) Resource descriptor class, e.g. Desc_OreIron_C.
- `type` (String) node, geyser, water, fracking or fracking_satellite.
- `x` (Number) Position in whole centimetres.
- `y` (Number) Position in whole centimetres.
- `yaw` (Number) Default rotation an extractor gets here, in degrees.
- `z` (Number) Position in whole centimetres. For water, the volume's centre at surface height.

### Nested Schema for `nodes.bounds_max`

Read-Only:

- `y` (Number)
- `z` (Number)
